introHtml: White bowls, plates, and trays offer a clean, neutral canvas for your logo or message. Whether you need pet bowls for a veterinary promotion, melamine plates for a restaurant grand opening, or serving trays for a corporate event, white ensures your branding stands out without competing with the product color. Many white items, like ceramic pet bowls or melamine trays, accept full-color screen printing or pad printing for crisp, vibrant logos that last through repeated dishwasher use.
